entries.title: Karaoke - Classic OPM Love Songs Medley
entries.evidence: Public YouTube result snapshot observed 2026-10-08: verified Ibarra Music channel; description lists Don't Know What To Do/Don't Know What To Say (Ric Segreto), Getting To Know Each Other (Ariel Rivera), and Closer You and I (Gino Padilla). Accumulated views support established reach, not current search demand. Listening/presentation/key remain unreviewed.
entries.note: Sustained playback verified: 17 readable samples over 15.011 seconds, 15.0 seconds of advancement, and 15 advancing intervals including 6 in the final five seconds.

entries.title: OPM Love Songs Medley (Female) - Karaoke HD
entries.evidence: Public YouTube result snapshot observed 2026-10-08: description identifies songs associated with Jam Morales, Kuh Ledesma, and Odette Quesada; uploader claims high-quality audio and up to 4K, neither independently verified. Listening, exact key, guide vocals, completeness, and presentation remain unreviewed.

entries.title: Parokya ni Edgar Medley - karaoke (Aggar Karaoke version)
entries.evidence: Public YouTube result snapshot observed 2026-10-08: description lists Buloy, Para Sayo, Your Song, Alumni Homecoming, and One Hit Combo. Channel audience is small (about 1.47K followers at snapshot); popularity is modest and audio/presentation/key remain unreviewed.
entries.note: Sustained playback verified: 17 readable samples over 15.006 seconds, 15.0 seconds of advancement, and 15 advancing intervals including 5 in the final five seconds.

entries.title: Pilipino Medley Karaoke - Mabuhay Singers

Low public reach and unknown sections make this a lower-priority human-review candidate; audio/presentation/key remain unreviewed.
